usedFor: BigMailer holds contacts and lists, and Calendly receives a booking link from “Create Scheduling Link” when a contact is added.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in BigMailer, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new subscriber is when a booking link is useful, and the action creates one.

watchOut: “New Contact” in BigMailer is polling, so the booking link appears after a scheduled check.
